system.flavor:
Skip a shot off two walls to ring a bell at the end of a crooked hall, knock a lever and a lantern with one bounce, or send a shot around two corners of an alley to hit a mark you have never seen directly. Carry a signal down a bent tunnel with a single thrown stone.

Not enough to go through anything solid along the way.

body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within ranged Weapon Range along one bent, unobstructed path.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage. Measure the full path through the first target's space to the second.

surges.html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against both targets.
Push one hit target 1 unit in the direction of the last path segment.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: After resolving, you may transfer existing Lock between the targets. The new target is Locked through ordinary concealment until your next turn.
